newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina 1H96 net profit 115.1 bln lire.
newsitem.headline: Gemina 1H96 net profit 115.1 bln lire.

text.p: The Italian financial holding group said its results did not include its 20.9 percent stake in Cartiere Burgo SpA, but did include its Gemina Capital Markets unit.

The group said in a statement that its net consolidated loss for 1995 was being restated at 678.5 billion lire after the company had said its loss was 694.5 billion lire at its annual shareholders meeting in June.
Gemina had at that meeting increased its 1995 losses as a result of higher charges due to losses at Gemina Capital Markets and Gemina Financial Products.
Gemina's 1995 accounts have been the subject of scrutiny after an investigation into alleged fradulent book-keeping was opened late last year into the company and its RCS editorial unit.
